name: @playform/ets-hook-dsh-normalize-ellipsis
description: The ellipsis hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that hooks the llm/stream waterfall — the interceptable wrapper around EVERY streaming model call — and normalizes the horizontal ellipsis (U+2026 — the typographic three-dot run collapsed into one code point by text processors) in model output streams, the family's ellipsis flavor — the CLASS flavor: the core's Ellipsis class replaced by the configurable replacement string (default "..." — the ASCII three-dot sequence), applied to text/reasoning deltas and assembled block-end blocks while tool-call deltas pass through untouched.
